entries.title: AlphaForge: A Framework to Mine and Dynamically Combine Formulaic Alpha Factors
entries.systemMapping: Bounded symbolic generation, lineage and train-only diversity pruning cover the auditable symbolic-search layer.
entries.implementationBoundary: The public package does not reproduce AlphaForge's neural generator or claim its empirical performance.
entries.requiredData: Point-in-time cross-sectional panels with frozen train/validation/shadow partitions.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare a frozen grammar family with economic seeds under one cumulative trial ledger.

entries.title: Cognitive Alpha Mining via LLM-Driven Code-Based Evolution
entries.systemMapping: The repository implements bounded mutation, crossover, immutable lineage and fail-closed evaluation.
entries.implementationBoundary: No LLM is permitted to emit or execute arbitrary code; this is not a CogAlpha reproduction.
entries.requiredData: Point-in-time features, immutable candidate ledger and an independently frozen evaluation protocol.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Submit LLM proposals through the same allowlisted DSL and compare novelty and rejection rates without changing acceptance gates.

entries.title: AlphaBench: A Benchmark for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
entries.systemMapping: A preregistered public protocol compares bounded CoE, ToT and evolutionary proposal strategies under one DSL, candidate budget and train-only selection rule.
entries.implementationBoundary: This is a paper-inspired orchestration layer, not a reproduction of the paper's data or reported results; no LLM may judge factor validity or inspect held-out feedback.
entries.requiredData: Point-in-time panels with a frozen train/validation/shadow split and a cumulative candidate trial ledger.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare per-arm uniqueness, parent improvement and Stage-2 survival under the same deterministic falsification pipeline.

entries.title: Vector-Quantized Discrete Latent Factors Meet Financial Priors: Dynamic Cross-Sectional Stock Ranking Prediction for Portfolio Construction
entries.systemMapping: Motivates future tests of discrete latent states alongside explicit financial priors.
entries.implementationBoundary: Vector quantization, mixture-of-experts routing and learned latent factors are not implemented.
entries.requiredData: Large point-in-time cross-sectional panels and a separately preregistered neural training protocol.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Test whether a frozen discrete-state representation adds OOS ranking value over explicit factors on identical support.

entries.title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
entries.systemMapping: Provides a candidate representation benchmark for candlestick and volatility forecasting.
entries.implementationBoundary: No Kronos weights, tokenizer or inference path ships in this repository.
entries.requiredData: OHLCV sequences with vendor provenance, fixed horizons and contamination-audited evaluation dates.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Freeze one public checkpoint and compare zero-shot features with price-only baselines under purged walk-forward.

entries.title: AI-Trader: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in Real-Time Financial Markets
entries.systemMapping: Frozen specifications and tamper-evident forward records implement the uncontaminated-evaluation principle without an agent.
entries.implementationBoundary: The package contains no autonomous news agent, broker access, order path or live-trading benchmark.
entries.requiredData: Predictions committed before outcome maturity and scored only after the frozen horizon closes.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare preregistered model cards on the same forward ledger while keeping all outputs research-only.

entries.title: Characteristics Are Covariances: A Unified Model of Risk and Return
entries.systemMapping: Motivates conditioning latent exposures on point-in-time characteristics.
entries.implementationBoundary: Instrumented PCA estimation is not included; neutralization is not IPCA.
entries.requiredData: Long point-in-time characteristic panels with stable identifiers and delisting coverage.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Benchmark frozen IPCA factors against explicit characteristic factors on the same investible universe.

entries.title: Factor Timing with Portfolio Characteristics
entries.systemMapping: Motivates preregistered conditional factor timing rather than validation-driven weight switching.
entries.implementationBoundary: Block-replica weight sensitivity is implemented, but online factor timing is forbidden.
entries.requiredData: Long factor-return history and characteristics known at each allocation date.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Fit timing rules only on rolling training blocks and report the gap from hindsight factor selection.

entries.title: Multifactor Timing with Deep Learning
entries.systemMapping: Provides a multitask alternative for testing whether shared structure improves factor-sign forecasts.
entries.implementationBoundary: No LSTM, multitask neural network or deep timing policy is implemented.
entries.requiredData: Long, bias-controlled factor returns and predictors with a fully frozen rolling protocol.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare multitask predictions with equal-weight and linear timing baselines under the same cost model.

entries.title: Meta-Learning the Optimal Mixture of Strategies for Online Portfolio Selection
entries.systemMapping: Motivates comparison of frozen ensembles with adaptive mixtures under regime drift.
entries.implementationBoundary: No online learner changes strategy weights in this research-only package.
entries.requiredData: Causal strategy returns, realistic turnover and a preregistered update schedule.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Measure whether an online mixture beats equal weight after costs without reading validation or shadow outcomes.

entries.title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Ensemble Gaussian Process Regression
entries.systemMapping: Provides a nonlinear probabilistic benchmark for cross-sectional forecasting.
entries.implementationBoundary: Probability calibration is available, but Gaussian-process forecasting is not implemented.
entries.requiredData: Point-in-time characteristics, frozen kernels and an independently calibrated probability block.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare calibrated GPR predictions with linear and symbolic candidates on identical dates and names.

entries.title: Continuous Hidden Markov Models for Equity Returns: Heavy-Tail Emission Families and Regime-Conditional Value-at-Risk
entries.systemMapping: Directly motivates replacing Gaussian-only emissions with preregistered heavy-tail families.
entries.implementationBoundary: The existing causal HMM is a fixed two-state Gaussian filter; heavy-tail estimation and VaR are absent.
entries.requiredData: Causal returns with a train-only emission-family choice and forward-filtered state probabilities.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Hold the state count fixed and test Student-t emissions against Gaussian emissions on calibration and tail-risk metrics.

entries.title: Observed Fisher Information in Hidden Markov Models - Application to a Noisy Gaussian Random Walk
entries.systemMapping: Motivates reporting parameter uncertainty instead of treating fitted HMM parameters as known.
entries.implementationBoundary: Observed Fisher information and parameter confidence intervals are not implemented.
entries.requiredData: A frozen likelihood specification, train-only parameter estimates and enough transitions for identification.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Quantify whether parameter uncertainty changes state-probability calibration on untouched periods.

entries.title: Decoding Chinese Stock Market Returns: Three-State Hidden Semi-Markov Model
entries.systemMapping: Motivates explicit state-duration tests for Chinese equity regimes.
entries.implementationBoundary: The public HMM has geometric state durations and two states; no HSMM is implemented.
entries.requiredData: Long return histories with enough independent regime transitions for duration estimation.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare frozen two-state HMM and three-state HSMM probabilities under purged chronological validation.

entries.title: Deep LPPLS: Forecasting of Temporal Critical Points in Natural, Engineering and Financial Systems
entries.systemMapping: The fixed-grid classic LPPLS primitive supplies a transparent feasibility baseline.
entries.implementationBoundary: Deep LPPLS is deliberately excluded until classic LPPLS shows stable incremental value.
entries.requiredData: Many independent bubble episodes, fixed window scans and untouched temporal holdouts.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: First require stable classic LPPLS residual and critical-time distributions across periods and asset groups.

entries.title: Quantifying Reflexivity in Financial Markets: Towards a Prediction of Flash Crashes
entries.systemMapping: Motivates a Hawkes endogeneity diagnostic for clustered high-risk market events.
entries.implementationBoundary: No Hawkes estimator is included because daily or bar data cannot identify event excitation reliably.
entries.requiredData: Timestamped trade or order-book events with validated clocks, session boundaries and event definitions.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Audit event-time coverage and recover excitation on synthetic processes before any market hypothesis test.

entries.title: The Self-Organized Criticality Paradigm in Economics and Finance
entries.systemMapping: Supplies a hypothesis vocabulary for clustered activity, avalanches and endogenous fragility.
entries.implementationBoundary: No SOC score or avalanche process is represented as a validated financial feature.
entries.requiredData: Preregistered event definitions across multiple regimes and instruments, not visual power-law fits.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Test scaling and alternative generative explanations before defining any SOC-derived feature.

entries.title: Generalized Stochastic Resilience for Early Warning Signals Based on Koopman Operator
entries.systemMapping: Provides a principled bridge between the existing EWS and DMD/Koopman primitives.
entries.implementationBoundary: Generalized stochastic resilience is not implemented; EWS and DMD remain separate diagnostics.
entries.requiredData: Equally spaced multivariate windows with train-frozen delay dimension and adequate transition events.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Test incremental transition calibration versus EWS alone on the same causal windows.

entries.title: Predicting Critical Transitions with Machine Learning Trained on Surrogates of Historical Data
entries.systemMapping: Motivates surrogate-trained transition classifiers after simple causal diagnostics are exhausted.
entries.implementationBoundary: Cross-domain surrogate ML is not implemented and cannot validate a financial signal by analogy.
entries.requiredData: Many independent market transitions and a frozen simulator family with explicit misspecification tests.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Show that surrogate-trained predictions remain calibrated under held-out real regimes and simulator perturbations.

entries.title: Tipping Point Detection and Early Warnings in Climate, Ecological, and Human Systems
entries.systemMapping: Frames failure modes and validation requirements for generic early-warning indicators.
entries.implementationBoundary: Evidence from nonfinancial systems is methodological context, not financial validation.
entries.requiredData: Independent labeled transitions and negative controls within the target financial domain.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Audit false alarms, lead time and regime specificity rather than reporting EWS correlation alone.

entries.title: Finite-Sample Borel--Cantelli Inequalities under Mixing Conditions
entries.systemMapping: Motivates replacing independent-trial confidence claims when observations are serially dependent.
entries.implementationBoundary: The current Hoeffding primitive exposes but does not correct its independence limitation.
entries.requiredData: A defensible mixing model or empirically bounded dependence coefficients.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Compare nominal and dependence-adjusted coverage on frozen block-dependent simulations.

entries.title: Fuk-Nagaev Inequality in Smooth Banach Spaces: Optimum Bounds for Distributions of Heavy-Tailed Martingales
entries.systemMapping: Motivates a heavy-tail and martingale-aware alternative to bounded independent Hoeffding intervals.
entries.implementationBoundary: No Fuk-Nagaev bound or martingale-difference diagnostic is implemented.
entries.requiredData: Explicit tail-moment assumptions and a testable martingale filtration.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: Validate finite-sample coverage under preregistered heavy-tail simulations before market use.

entries.title: Quantile of Means: A Bonus-Free Ensemble Method for Minimax Optimal Reinforcement Learning
entries.systemMapping: No direct mapping to the current point-in-time factor validation contract.
entries.implementationBoundary: An RL confidence construction is not treated as a trading factor without a separately specified decision process.
entries.requiredData: Not applicable to the current scope.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: No implementation planned unless a bounded offline decision problem is preregistered.

entries.title: Establishing an Omega(sqrt(d)) Complexity Lower Bound for PDMP Samplers and How to Break It: A Sub-sqrt(d) Algorithm for Gaussian-Tailed Targets
entries.systemMapping: No current sampler requires this result.
entries.implementationBoundary: Sampling complexity theory is not presented as alpha generation.
entries.requiredData: Not applicable to the current scope.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: No implementation planned.

entries.title: Simplex Faces and Quadratic Toric Ideals of Lattice Polytopes
entries.systemMapping: No defensible connection to the package's research mechanisms.
entries.implementationBoundary: Mathematical sophistication alone is not a finance mechanism.
entries.requiredData: Not applicable to the current scope.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: No implementation planned.

entries.title: Fractional Excitations in Kitaev Quasi-One-Dimensional Chain
entries.systemMapping: No defensible connection to financial point-in-time prediction.
entries.implementationBoundary: Physical terminology is not transferred into factor definitions by analogy.
entries.requiredData: Not applicable to the current scope.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: No implementation planned.

entries.title: Existence of Weak Solutions of the Surface Beris--Edwards Model
entries.systemMapping: No causal financial observable or testable market mechanism has been specified.
entries.implementationBoundary: The PDE model is not repurposed as a price predictor.
entries.requiredData: Not applicable to the current scope.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: No implementation planned.

entries.title: Reading Weakly, Acting Strongly: A Static Parity Horizon and Its Dynamical Bypass in the Monitored Lipkin--Meshkov--Glick Model
entries.systemMapping: A monitored quantum-system result has no specified mapping to market concentration bounds or causal features.
entries.implementationBoundary: No quantum-information objective is used in validation.
entries.requiredData: Not applicable to the current scope.
entries.nextFalsifiableStep: No implementation planned.
